title: A record inside bone
hook: A cut surface can show layers invisible outside.

knows: Bones can grow and preserve internal tissue.
doesNotKnow: Treat bone growth marks as evidence with timing uncertainty.

misconception: Every visible mark necessarily represents exactly one year.
objective: Treat bone growth marks as evidence with timing uncertainty.

claims.text: A cut surface can show layers invisible outside. A fossil bone section shows repeated growth marks. What is a careful interpretation? The schematic section shows growth marks in bone tissue. Such marks can inform studies of growth, but their timing and preservation need validation; counting marks alone is not automatically an exact age in years.
